meta.title: Jaris, your AI assistant on your PC
meta.desc: Jaris is an AI assistant that runs directly on your Windows computer. Private, free, no subscription, and it actually does things on your PC.
hero.orbAlt: The Jaris orb: a glowing turquoise ring with a rippling edge
hero.tagline: Your AI assistant. On your PC. Just for you.
hero.lead: Like ChatGPT, but it runs directly on your computer. Your conversations go nowhere, and it works even without the Internet.
strong.private.p: Nothing leaves your PC. Nobody reads your conversations, nobody sells your data.
strong.free.p: No subscription, no hidden paid version. You download it, you use it.
strong.acts.p: It doesn't just talk. You ask, and it opens, writes, searches and reminds you.
demo.title: Watch it work
demo.intro: A short demo is worth more than a long speech.
demo.alt.voice: Jaris in voice mode, with its orb
feat.title: What Jaris can do
feat.intro: One assistant to talk, write, create and remember. Everything happens on your machine.
voice.p: Say “Jaris” or click the orb, then just talk. It answers out loud and takes care of what you ask on your PC.
voice.said: “Jaris, remind me to call the garage at 5 pm”
voice.reply: Got it, I'll remind you at 5 pm.
chat.t: Write to it like you would to ChatGPT
chat.p: Ask your questions in writing, keep several conversations going and come back to them later. If you know ChatGPT, you'll feel at home.
chat.me: Make me a shopping list for the week
chat.j: Here's a list sorted by aisle. Want me to add breakfast?
code.p: Describe a game or a tool in one sentence. Jaris builds it and you try it right away in a preview, right next to it. If you already code, it can also work on a GitHub project.
media.t: Images and videos, made at home
media.p: Describe what you want to see: Jaris generates the image, or a short video. Here too, everything is made by your PC and nothing is sent anywhere.
mem.p: Jaris has a memory, which it calls its Brain. Tell it once when your sister's birthday is or how you like your coffee: it will remember next time.
mem.v3: Sport on Tuesday and Thursday evenings
duel.t: It picks the best AIs for your machine
duel.p: With Duels, two AI models answer the same question without you knowing which is which. You vote for the answer you prefer, and Jaris keeps the winners.
away.t: On your phone, and always within reach
away.p: You can talk to Jaris from your phone, even far from your PC. And on your desktop, a small floating widget stays one click away while you do something else.
away.cap: The floating widget, on top of your other windows.
langs.p: Jaris speaks your language, and 23 others. Handy for sharing it with someone who doesn't speak yours.
cmp.intro: Both chat with you. The difference is where it happens.
cmp.c1: To a company's servers, over the Internet
cmp.c2: Limited free version, subscription for the rest
cmp.fine: To be honest: a PC is no match for a data center. On very advanced questions, ChatGPT can be stronger and faster. Jaris, though, belongs to you.
setup.1p: Jaris is a Windows app. You run the installer and off you go.
setup.2t: An NVIDIA graphics card, if possible
setup.2p: It's not required, but it's recommended: Jaris answers faster and can run better models.
setup.3p: On first launch, Jaris installs what it needs and picks the models that suit your machine by itself.
faq.a1: Yes. No subscription, no credits to buy. The AI runs on your computer, so it costs me nothing to keep it running for you.
faq.a2: No. Your conversations, your voice and Jaris's memory stay on your PC. Jaris only goes online when you ask it to, for example for a web search.
faq.q3: Do I need a powerful PC?
faq.a3: Not necessarily. Jaris looks at your machine and picks models that suit it. With an NVIDIA graphics card, it will be faster and smarter. Without one, it still works, just more slowly.
faq.q4: Does it work without the Internet?
faq.a4: Yes, once it's installed. You need a connection to download it and for the first launch, while it fetches its models. After that, only the features that need the web (search, access from your phone) require a connection.
faq.a5: Me, Léo. I've been building Jaris on my own for five months, because I wanted an assistant that truly belongs to me.
